latest_release.name: CCBaga 0.2.50
latest_release.body:
CCBaga combines recoverable local Claude identities, CLI management, real environment checks and an isolated companion browser.

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Apple Silicon · A + B | [Download](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/releases/download/v0.2.50/CCBaga-0.2.50-macos-arm64.dmg) |
| Windows x64 · A + B | [Download](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/releases/download/v0.2.50/CCBaga-0.2.50-windows-x86_64-setup.exe) |
| Linux DEB | [Download](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/releases/download/v0.2.50/CCBaga-0.2.50-linux-x86_64.deb) |
| Linux RPM | [Download](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/releases/download/v0.2.50/CCBaga-0.2.50-linux-x86_64.rpm) |
| Linux AppImage | [Download](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/releases/download/v0.2.50/CCBaga-0.2.50-linux-x86_64.AppImage) |
| Arch/pacman | [Download](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/releases/download/v0.2.50/CCBaga-0.2.50-linux-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst) |

Each installer contains both applications. On macOS drag both apps into Applications. On Windows run the setup installer; SmartScreen may show a warning because the installer has no Authenticode certificate. Organization policy can restrict installation.

Sidebar updates verify signed downloads: macOS updates A, Windows updates A and B. Linux uses its package manager. The archive and latest.json are used by automatic updates; ordinary installation only needs the platform installer. SHA256SUMS covers public downloads.

[Usage](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga#readme) · [Network Skill](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/tree/main/skills/ccbaga-network)

This release fixes local Claude identity round trips for generated debug pointers and configuration backups, strengthens browser profile ownership and region checks, and updates vulnerable application dependencies.

The companion engine remains pinned to Fingerprint Chromium 148.0.7778.215. Its fork-specific security backport coverage has not been independently verified; see the [security boundaries and audit record](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/blob/main/src-tauri/SECURITY.md).
